header: THE TEXT COLOURS OF AN ANNOUNCEMENT: the five swatches of the editor's toolbar (src/components/RichTextEditor.tsx) and, the same list, the only colours the saving code keeps (src/lib/announcements/contentProcessing.ts). I keep one list, so that what the toolbar can paint and what is allowed to be stored cannot drift apart. A colour that is not here (the pale grey that text copied from a web page, a chat or a document carries with it) is never saved or shown: it made an announcement's body look dimmed.

symbols.name: paletteColourPatterns
doc: I build the patterns (for sanitize-html) that match exactly the palette: each colour as the editor writes it (#rrggbb) and as the browser gives it back when a saved announcement is opened for editing (rgb(r, g, b)).
